function Trig_Flame_Burst_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
    call CreateNUnitsAtLoc( 1, 'h00W', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()), bj_UNIT_FACING )
    call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 3.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
    call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0CV', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
    call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A0CV', GetLastCreatedUnit(), ( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped(GetSpellAbilityId(), GetTriggerUnit()) + ( 4 * GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R048', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit())) ) ) )
    call IssueImmediateOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "thunderclap" )
endfunction
